explication: refactoring.nvim is a Neovim plugin for Tree-sitter- and LSP-powered code refactoring and debug-print operations. A user invokes an operation through the public Lua API (often via an operator/keymap); the operation uses language queries and, for inline operations, LSP definitions/references to modify the buffer. The README documents these capabilities and requirements, but no source excerpts were provided, so internal call relationships beyond those documented are omitted.
